title: Guidelines for Examination of Ayush Related Inventions
content: Ayush related inventions include products, equipment, devices, food recipes and nutraceuticals. Such inventions may receive IP protection subject to the patentability requirements under the Patents Act, 1970.

title: Patents Act 1970 Section 3
content: An invention which in effect is traditional knowledge or an aggregation or duplication of known properties of traditionally known components is not patentable. Certain new forms, uses, admixtures and treatment methods are also excluded under Section 3.

title: Basics of Patents
content: A patent may be granted for a new product or process involving an inventive step and capable of industrial application. Novelty, inventive step and industrial applicability are key patentability criteria.

title: Patent Jurisdiction
content: For applicants in Uttar Pradesh, the appropriate Patent Office jurisdiction is New Delhi.

title: Trade Marks
content: A trademark can protect a distinctive brand name, logo, symbol or other mark used to distinguish goods or services.

title: Patent Route
content: For a patentable Ayurvedic invention, the relevant route is patent protection subject to novelty, inventive step, industrial applicability and applicable exclusions.

title: Copyright
content: Copyright protection applies to original literary and artistic works, including books and other original written works.

title: Geographical Indications
content: A Geographical Indication identifies goods as originating from a specific geographical region where a given quality, reputation or other characteristic is attributable to that geographical origin.
